entities.title: status line
entities.summary: `zazzle status` reports the daemon's version, pid, uptime, cache, walk and session counters in one line.
entities.name: status
entities.meaning: Whether a daemon answers, which process it is, and how its caches are doing: hot and stored metadata records, cache hits and misses, directory walks scanned and reused, and sessions tracked.
entities.access: Any caller of the daemon's own uid, through `zazzle status`. It is not an MCP tool; `zazzled run status` reports a fresh in-process engine, so its counters start at zero.
entities.retention: Kept in daemon memory only; reset when the daemon exits.

entities.title: clean --stats line
entities.summary: `zazzle clean --stats` ends its answer with the token estimate before and after and the steps that changed the text.
entities.name: [clean ~A→~B tokens; steps: ...]
entities.meaning: How much cleaning saved for this one input, and which steps did it (ansi, whitespace, json, grep, repeats, progress, blobs, long-lines, budget), or `none`.
entities.access: The caller of that clean command, in its answer.
entities.retention: Part of the answer, so it is kept with it in the output store for an hour when the answer is stored (macos/rust/zazzled/src/outputs.rs MAX_AGE); not kept otherwise.
